text: Uh, it's a amazing experience, I have to say, because, uh, Mugello is, uh, like my second home. We spend, uh, so many days here to develop, uh, all the car from '99 to 2008. I have to say that, uh, Mugello is a special track, uh, for development because, uh, in this, in this circuit you can found, uh, many kind of corner. You have a long straight corner with a big range, slow corner, fast corner, up and down. So you can found, uh, a lot of situation that you compare in other circuit. So this was, uh, the, the point that we spend, uh, in the past, uh, so many time here. Um, so i-i-it was really fantastic period. Fantastic, the best, uh, period of my life for Ferrari because I have my two son in that period. And, uh, when I remember at that time, it, yeah, it's, uh... I think that I was very lucky because I was a part of, uh, success of Ferrari. Uh, the test, um, the work of the test is on the dark side. You don't see, but is, uh, especially on that period was very heavy, very important, and, uh, very hard work. We spend, uh, many days, uh, in, in, in the circuit from the 8:00 the morning to the 8:00, uh, in, in the evening sometime. And, um, in this situation, uh, with, with Michael, obviously we become, uh, before, uh, very closed for the technical side, for the development of the car, but I consider him like, uh, my brother now because the, the friendship, uh, that, um, born on that, uh, on that period is really, was really strong. And, um, we spend many time together also out of the track. But especially when it was, when we, we did a, um, test together was even better because, uh, I mean, uh, the other driver was a very big friend. I think that when you are a superstar, because Schumacher at that time was a superstar, um, you cannot, uh, give attention to everybody. Of course. It's normal. But, uh, for sure is, uh, one of the best people that I met in my life, for the human side, for the heart side. When you have something to do with him, you can, uh, you can trust fully on him. Obviously, is not, uh, many people that can have, uh, this relationship, uh, because, uh, you have to be close to him. But when you understand him, uh, you, you see him in another, in another way, for sure.
